description: This file defines the procedurally generated tilemap for a Metroidvania-style game world, including terrain, gates, secrets, and associated world initialization logic. It provides functions for map generation, gate passability checks, and world state creation.

methods.name: makeArray(w, h, fill)
methods.description: Creates an array of specified width and height filled with a given value.

methods.name: stampHLine(data, width, y, x1, x2, id)
methods.description: Stamps a horizontal line of tiles across the data array.

methods.name: stampVLine(data, width, x, y1, y2, id)
methods.description: Stamps a vertical line of tiles across the data array.

methods.name: stampRect(data, width, x1, y1, x2, y2, id)
methods.description: Fills a rectangular area with a specific tile id.

methods.name: genMetroidvaniaMap()
methods.description: Generates a procedural tilemap representing interconnected biomes with areas, gates, secrets, and zones.

methods.name: isGatePassable(gateTileId, tiles, playerAbilities)
methods.description: Checks if a gate tile is currently passable based on player's abilities.

methods.name: computeUnlockedNodes(world)
methods.description: Returns a list of accessible map nodes based on current world state.

methods.name: createInitialWorld()
methods.description: Creates and returns the initial game world object with tiles, hazards, enemies, and other metadata.
